Preregistered 2017-train/2018-test Meaher oxygen-percent replication (n=136 held-out days) worsened RMSE from 14.47156 to 15.00879 (+3.71%); MAE 11.84995 to 11.91685; delta MSE +15.8375; paired 97.5% block interval [-27.10, 69.49]; worsened 7/11 blocks. Calendar and estimate-free sensitivities also worsened. This rejects the fixed lag as a production feature; it is not a Jubilee-event test.
